title: Causal Micro-Probes Predict Which Teacher–Student–Data Triads Distill
falsification_prediction: Build 12 triads from Qwen3-1.7B and Qwen3-4B students; Qwen3-8B, Qwen3-14B, and DeepSeek-R1-Distill-Qwen-7B teachers; and DAPO-Math-17K versus the MATH training split, then measure the probe and the 5-million-token full-OPD exact-answer gain on MATH-500 and AIME 2024. If the idea works, leave-one-teacher-family-out Spearman rho between Teacher-Causal Response R(c) and final OPD gain stays positive and exceeds the corresponding rho for top-k overlap, local teacher margin, peak confidence, teacher accuracy, and naive early gain; selecting the top three triads by R also lowers final-gain regret relative to those baselines. The ONE load-bearing variable is R(c), the matched TEACH-minus-SELF fraction of verifier-measured teacher headroom. As a non-identity negative-control intervention on that response, keep the candidate teacher, target marginals, Bc, token count, optimizer, and probe compute fixed but randomly permute its cached target distributions across different prefixes within Bc before training the placebo TEACH arm; triads selected by the resulting placebo R should return to random-selection downstream full-OPD gain, otherwise the claimed teacher-causal interpretation is falsified.
core_mechanism: For each triad c=(T,S,D), sample 512 prompts uniformly without replacement from the named training set D and generate one rollout per prompt from the initial student checkpoint S0; this fixed training buffer Bc is the controlled instance set, and the only manipulated artifact is the source of supervision on the same student-visited prefixes. Separately fix one shared 256-example held-out evaluation split ED for every triad, disjoint from both training sets; for each S0, greedily generate its ED rollouts and store one cut point sampled uniformly from the middle two quartiles in an evaluation buffer Ec. Fork S0 into two LoRA-rank-16 replicas with identical optimizer state and train each for K=2^18 student response tokens using the unchanged standard MiniLLM/GKD implementation: the TEACH arm queries T on every training prefix in Bc, whereas the SELF arm queries a frozen copy of S0 on the identical prefixes. Let Ateach(c), Aself(c), and A0(c) be exact-answer pass@1 on the shared ED after TEACH, after SELF, and before either update, respectively; all decoding uses greedy generation and the dataset's existing exact-answer verifier. Compute Ahandoff(c) on the same ED prompts by asking T to complete from Ec's stored S0 cut points and scoring the completed answers with that verifier; this is an outcome-scale proxy for teacher handoff headroom on states S actually visits, not teacher confidence or a model-judged label. Define Teacher-Causal Response R(c)=[Ateach(c)-Aself(c)]/max[0.05, Ahandoff(c)-A0(c)]; if Ahandoff(c)-A0(c)<0.05, label the triad no-headroom and place it in a tied bottom tier rather than interpreting the floored ratio. Thus R is an observed plug-in normalized excess response: its numerator contrasts candidate-teacher supervision against matched optimizer, data, rollout, and self-distillation drift, while its denominator puts that contrast in the same ED exact-answer units as measured handoff headroom; R is not claimed to be finite-sample unbiased or bounded to [0,1]. Apply the identical probe and decision rule to every triad without refitting. Use midranks for Spearman ties, and compute top-3 selection regret by averaging uniformly over all admissible top-three subsets when a tie crosses the selection boundary. Evaluate against final OPD gain after 5 million student response tokens, holding out in turn an entire teacher family, a capacity-ratio band, and one of DAPO-Math-17K versus MATH training prompts. This is a pre-training measurement only: it never reweights tokens, changes the KL objective, truncates supervision adaptively, inserts a teacher assistant, or alters the subsequent full OPD recipe.
core_mechanism_steps:
1. Download the existing open-weight Qwen3-1.7B/4B students and Qwen3-8B/14B plus DeepSeek-R1-Distill-Qwen-7B teachers, form same-tokenizer triads over DAPO-Math-17K and the existing MATH training split, validate that every D contains at least 512 prompts, and predeclare one shared 256-example ED disjoint from both training sets; output the triad manifest and ED.
2. For each triad, uniformly sample 512 prompts from D, generate one S0 rollout per prompt, and store every token prefix in an immutable training buffer Bc. Separately generate one greedy S0 rollout for every ED prompt and store one cut point sampled uniformly from its middle two quartiles in Ec; outputs are the all-prefix training buffer and the cut-point evaluation buffer.
3. Run T and the frozen S0 copy at every training prefix in Bc to cache teacher and self target distributions consumed by the unchanged baseline OPD code; inputs are Bc, T, and S0, outputs are the two aligned supervision sources.
4. Fork two byte-identical rank-16 LoRA students and train TEACH and SELF for exactly 2^18 student response tokens with the same optimizer seed and MiniLLM/GKD loss; inputs are the cached targets and Bc, outputs are two probe checkpoints whose only designed difference is supervision source.
5. Greedily evaluate S0 and both probe checkpoints on the shared ED with the existing exact-answer verifier; inputs are the three checkpoints and ED, outputs are A0, Ateach, and Aself.
6. Ask T to complete from Ec's stored S0 cut points and score those completed ED answers with the same verifier; inputs are T and Ec, outputs are Ahandoff and the positive-headroom flag Ahandoff-A0>=0.05.
7. Compute R(c), place every no-headroom triad in one tied bottom tier, and rank positive-headroom triads without fitting a per-family threshold; use midranks for score ties. Inputs are the four same-ED accuracies; outputs are one score, eligibility decision, and rank per triad.
8. From the original S0 checkpoint, run the unchanged full OPD baseline for 5 million student response tokens for every triad and evaluate exact-answer pass@1; input is the triad manifest, output is the independent final-gain oracle.
9. Report leave-one-teacher-family-, capacity-band-, and dataset-out Spearman correlation plus top-3 selection regret for R and for overlap, local margin, peak confidence, teacher accuracy, and naive early gain. Require at least two triads in each reported correlation group; when a tie crosses the top-three boundary, report regret averaged uniformly over every admissible tied subset. Inputs are probe scores and full-run gains; output is the controlled transfer-gap result.
10. Replace T with the frozen S0 in both probe arms and rerun triad selection. Identical control scores receive midranks, and control top-3 regret is the uniform average over admissible tied subsets; this intervention propagates through the probe checkpoints to their generated answers, and that averaged selected-triad final gain should equal random-selection baseline if teacher-causal response is the load-bearing signal.
core_mechanism_reasoning:
BLOCK 1 — PREMISES ledger:
P1. Exact-answer pass@1 from the existing MATH/AIME verifier is a task-outcome measure independent of the teacher and student distributions; reason: answers are checked against dataset ground truth rather than by either model.
P2. Excess response during the first 2^18 student tokens preserves enough ordering information to predict gain after 5 million tokens across triads; untested — falsification target; reason: OPD's earliest updates are where teacher–student mismatch first acts before training changes the visitation distribution.
P3. The frozen-S0 SELF arm captures optimizer, replay-buffer, and student/data learning drift shared with the TEACH arm without containing candidate-teacher information; reason: both arms start from byte-identical weights, see the same training prefixes, and differ only in supervision source.
P4. Teacher handoff completion on the shared ED is an outcome-scale proxy for available handoff headroom on student-visited states; reason: Ahandoff and A0 are now scored on the same prompts in exact-answer units by the same independent verifier. Treating this proxy as attainable training headroom remains an empirical premise, not a guarantee.
OBSERVATION-MODEL premise. Bc is sampled by uniform prompts from D followed by one rollout from S0 and is therefore representative only of S0's initial training visitation distribution, not guaranteed unbiased for later OPD states; whether this initial-state sample suffices for final-gain ranking is untested — falsification target. ED is one predeclared held-out prompt set shared by every triad, and Ec is generated from each S0 on those prompts solely to align the handoff denominator with A0.
ESTIMAND. For eligible triads, the population target is theta(c)=[pteach(ED;c)-pself(ED;c)]/[phandoff(ED;c)-p0(ED;c)], conditional on the two pilots trained from Bc, where each p is exact-answer probability under uniform prompts from the shared ED and the fixed greedy policy. R(c) is the finite-ED plug-in estimate of theta(c); it is not asserted to be finite-sample unbiased or a [0,1]-bounded fraction.
BLOCK 2 — NAIVE-BASELINE AUDIT: The runnable naive version is to train one short TEACH pilot and rank triads by Ateach-A0. Branch (i): it silently assumes every early gain is caused by useful teacher information, but optimizer transients, replaying an easy D, and self-sharpening also move Ateach, so aligned-only gain is not teacher-specific; the matched SELF arm and same-ED outcome-headroom denominator confront that false premise directly. This resembles a controlled pilot or surrogate-endpoint design, but the domain-specific unsolved structure is that observations are adaptively selected autoregressive states from each different S, while the available intervention T and its handoff headroom are both prefix-dependent; the paired initial-state training buffer and shared-ED handoff buffer make the contrasts comparable without assuming common parameters or logits across students.
BLOCK 3 — Design rationale: The selection is anchor-only because cross-triad prediction can be tested with one controlled object, R(c); a full four-way causal taxonomy would require additional interventions and become a second paper. Static overlap/confidence aggregation was rejected because its units and calibration change with T and D, while gradient-alignment probes were rejected because gradients are not comparable across student architectures and would drift toward a representation-hint mechanism. The design also avoids regression to Curriculum Learning, teacher-assistant distillation, and target pacing: it decides whether a triad merits a full run but never changes sample order, inserts an intermediate teacher, or schedules the target.
